name: Solar Industries Nagastra-1

atlas_legacy_record.note: Values below come from the live legacy atlas page captured on 2026-09-02 and were NOT independently verified in this upgrade pass. They are carried forward for continuity only and must not be cited as evidence.

what_it_is: Nagastra-1 is Solar Industries' man-portable fixed-wing electric loitering munition, designed for the Indian Army with ~60-minute endurance and man-in-the-loop or autonomous attack modes. It was developed in India with high indigenous content and delivered its full first order in 2024.
india_angle: The Indian Army ordered Nagastra-1 under emergency procurement and received the entire lot of 480 munitions from Solar Industries by December 2024, per The Defense Post and other outlets - among the first fully indigenous loitering-munition inductions.
